style: Warm 2D storybook editorial illustration for a history-of-medicine documentary video: flat vector shapes with subtle paper grain, warm cream and parchment palette with deep teal, muted red and brass gold accents, herbal and anatomical motifs, dramatic cinematic lighting, consistent character design, wide cinematic framing, clear separation between foreground and background planes so layers can move independently, NO text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no logos, no UI elements.
